description:
## Empirical anchor

Arc 40 + Arc 41 (2026-05-18) accumulated 5 design.md probe-spec defects (filed at stoa--mn3) — all DAEDALUS-authored probes that violate the same probe-grounding discipline §5.11 covers for VERA-authored probes:
- Arc 40: VERA m1 (probe cites non-existent install.sh flag) + m2 (probe greps for output shape that doesn't match bw)
- Arc 41: ARGUS R1 (ASCII hyphens vs em-dash) + R2 (nonexistent §4.1.6b heading) + R3 (malformed inner regex)
- Arc 41: VERA m_4.5.2 (lowercase character class vs uppercase flag) + m_4.12.2 (word-boundary FP) + m_4.12.3 (over-match on enumerations)

The §5.11 anchoring discipline shipped Arc 40 (via stoa--3sz) targets CAPTAIN_VERA.md probe-authoring specifically. It does NOT cover DAEDALUS-authored probes inside `agents/design/<arc>/design.md` — which is where the 5+ recurrent defects accumulate.

DAEDALUS §6.4 in Arc 41 rev2 design.md explicitly proposed this canon-promotion as Arc 42+ follow-up:
> codify probe-grounding canon for DAEDALUS-authored design.md probes mirroring CAPTAIN_VERA.md §5.11 anchoring discipline (which targets substrate canon probes).

## Fix shape

Extend the §5.11 discipline (or add a parallel section in CAPTAIN_DAEDALUS.md / operating-disciplines.md) covering:
1. Regex anchoring (`^` / `$` / unique-substring-delimiters) when matching substrate canon prose
2. Character-class completeness (account for case flags + special chars in pattern)
3. Live round-trip — design-time author runs every probe command literally against current substrate state; failures surface immediately
4. Ground-check against shipped tool surface (don't assume tool flags or output shapes without verification)

The cleanest landing site is probably CAPTAIN_DAEDALUS.md (mirrors CAPTAIN_VERA §5.11) with a cross-ref to the §5.11 sibling for the VERA-side analog.

## Sequencing

P3. Arc 42+. Substantive substrate-canon edit (not appropriate for direct-to-main housekeeping). Pairs naturally with other canon-edit work in next discipline-accretion bundle.

## Cross-references

- stoa--mn3 — design.md housekeeping fixes for the 5 specific findings (separate scope; housekeeping not canon)
- stoa--3sz — original §5.11 ship (Arc 40)
- stoa--bbi — refined-principle thesis evidence (this is exactly the kind of "structural fix at narrower scope; iteration discloses propagation gap" the thesis covers)
- DAEDALUS §6.4 (substrate/CAPTAIN_DAEDALUS.md after Arc 41 ship) — explicit canon-promotion proposal
title: Extend §5.11 probe-anchoring discipline to DAEDALUS-authored design.md probes (5-finding mn3 cluster + DAEDALUS §6.4 proposal)
